\section{Experiments}
We compare two classifiers on a fixed test set. Each model was trained once. We conclude our method is consistently better across random initializations.

\section{Results}
Our algorithm was evaluated on ten generated examples. It achieved eight correct predictions. This proves our algorithm outperforms all existing methods on every real-world dataset.
